stop: Stop when every group's episodes have dec rows (generator cal/test 0-1999 for the cheap baselines, 0-499 for nuisance-SMC, H3/H4/H6/H7 0-499) or the day's owner cap is reached; these rows are the Stage C baselines table, the raw-posterior and conformal-selection certifiers, the alpha 0.05/0.1 own-guarantee table, per-fault-class and fault-shift analyses (docs/reviews/review_round0.md a-d).
_doc: Role baselines, review round 0 additions. Task `smc` (cfcap/baselines/smc.py:TASK) on generator episodes (--source gen: cfcap.gen.episode.make_episode ids, observed and labelled by the generator's own simrun), so capxfer and every other method share exactly the same cal/test/H* ids (review d). Each episode writes dec-schema rows per method incl. ep_n_faults and cand_fault_class. The certifiers added by the review are offline layers over those rows (scripts/baselines_pilot.py from-runs --split test --cal-split cal): raw posterior 5 % quantile (a), conformal selection at FDR 0.05/0.1 (b), SimultaneousLower at the methods' own alpha 0.05 and 0.1 + Mondrian per parent shape, per-fault-class strata and a doubled-fault-odds importance-weighted test (c). T2 rows for the same ids come from role stress. Total ~41 box-h, ~$7.5 at $0.18/h; unit_s are ESTIMATES until cfcap-baselines-pilot2 measures them. Every job is <= 33 min. Updates (2026-11-25, after the codex screen and scorer audits): enum_known propagates hypotheses to 1-1e-3 posterior mass or abstains, and records truth retention (truth_in_support, truth_retained, mass_true, dropped_mass); every cheap group also runs the E3 trivial baselines (detector_gated, physics_gains, copy_parent, weakest_member; model_free is offline); cheap groups cover generator cal 0-1999, test 0-1999 and H3/H4/H6/H7 0-499 (the models role's ids), SMC covers cal/test 0-499 of the same ids. The matched-compute SMC group lives in baselines_b2_matched.draft.json (pilot null until models measures its latency): replace --wall-budget-s 20 by the models role's median stage-2 end-to-end s/decision (docs/board/models.md) and unit_s by 2 x budget, then add a pilot line. SMC groups removed (2026-11-25): nuisance-SMC measured >= 500 s/episode; it now runs on 100 + 100 pair/square episodes in baselines_smc_small.json. b2-cheap-cal removed: calibration rows come from baselines_conf.json conf-cal (cal 0-1999, one code version).
